versions.body:
Welcome to my Harbor Festival page!

I have been a volunteer since 1979. I run the duck race and I will talk about ducks until you walk away, and then I will talk a little more.

This page lives on CalderWeb because I am not paying a designer. The pictures sometimes break. That is the computer, not the ducks.

Sign the guestbook. Visit the 2008 write-up. Count yourself lucky if the visitor number goes up.
Sign my guestbook! I read every one. I may not write back quickly.

comments.text: Best duck race since the eighties. Save me a yellow one.
Walt you still owe me a lemonade from 2003.
Nice page. The photo of the band did not load on my computer.

versions.body:
I have run the Harbor Festival duck race for years, and I intend to run it for years yet.

The ducks go in at the creek and come out at the harbour, except when they do not. I know a lot of them by the chips in the paint.

If you want to sponsor a duck, find me at the stall. Do not email the ducks.

Harbor Festival 2008 was a good one. The fog held off until the evening, the chowder stand ran out (as it should), and the duck race finished with a duck I had my eye on since Thursday.

I will put more pictures up when the scanner works. It does not work.
A few pages I like, and the webring I am in when the webring is in the mood.
